none: PAS CAM-E3C991: Roman Coin : Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint is uncertain, c.AD348-350, Reece period 18. Obverse shows pearl-diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]STA[...]. Reverse shows Emperor standing left on galley, holding standard, galley steered by Victory. Reverse legend reads [FEL TEMP] RE[PARATIO]. Condition is fair, die axis is 7 o'clock, weight…
